name: choice-group
title: Choice Group
description: One choice shown as buttons: sizes and options in explicit columns, colour swatches, or rows with a detail such as a price, with a note under the group.
docs: A radio group of buttons with one Tab stop. The arrow keys move and choose, and the group stops them, so a listener on the page, such as a gallery's, never sees them. Each button holds its label alone; in rows (variant="rows") each choice is a row of its own, a radio mark, the label at the start and its detail, a short figure such as a price, at the end, semibold in the numeric pair and named after the label; a detail that does not fit moves under the label, and false, null and an empty string are no detail. data-slot="choice-label" and "choice-detail" mark the two for a test. A choice that cannot be had is disabled, dashed and struck through, and says so in words (unavailableLabel, English by default). Say what the buttons do not carry, a surcharge or what cannot be had, in note, which the group points at with aria-describedby. Disabled, the group keeps its choice and its chosen look; with name it posts as a native radio group, the chosen value or nothing. Columns come from container queries in dist/tokens.css of the same release: one row when every choice gets 4rem, otherwise rows of one count, the last at most one shorter, never one alone, unless that takes two rows more than filling them; never a cell under the touch target. The group takes its parent's width; where that width comes from its content, it asks for three touch targets, 9.25rem, or one row of its choices where that is narrower. See DESIGN.md "Choosing one of a few".
